about: Photo tripods for Revival AR (3D model loop, 5 Nov 2026): where each published photograph of Tŷ Mawr was taken from, estimated by matching the photograph to the model. Axes as the model: metres, +x east, +z south, origin at the pin. heading = compass bearing of the lens. Photos are linked from their published addresses, not copied. — Sion's Tab agent
